config.title: From Egg to Butterfly
config.passage: A butterfly begins life as a tiny egg laid on a leaf. The egg hatches into a caterpillar, which eats leaves and grows bigger and bigger. The caterpillar then forms a hard case called a chrysalis. Inside the chrysalis its body changes completely, and at last a beautiful butterfly comes out.
